checkout_drafts_lengths.name: checkout_drafts_lengths
checkout_drafts_lengths.value: length("checkout_drafts"."phone") <= 20 and length("checkout_drafts"."name") <= 100 and length("checkout_drafts"."address") <= 500 and length("checkout_drafts"."product_name") <= 300

discounts_value.name: discounts_value
discounts_value.value: "discounts"."value" > 0 and ("discounts"."kind" = 'amount' or "discounts"."value" <= 100) and "discounts"."min_subtotal" >= 0 and ("discounts"."max_uses" is null or "discounts"."max_uses" > 0) and "discounts"."uses" >= 0
